[[Vengeance Seeker]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Delic the Vengeance Seeker]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Rhea's Crater]].

==Stats==
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Communing]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Communing]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
